name: moe_blockscale_dpp_dequant
description: Apply 128x128 FP8 block scales to an MFMA accumulator in-register by DPP-broadcasting one lane's scale across the block
preconditions: MoE gate+up or any block-scaled GEMM on gfx942/gfx950
scales already resident in 1-4 VGPRs per thread
steps: Load XQ/GQ/UQ scale dwords into pinned VGPRs at the end of the K-0..3 half so they are ready for dequant
Use a DPP (cross-lane) permute to broadcast the owner lane's scale to the 16 or 32 lanes that share a 128-element block
Combine scales as a single scalar per block: Z *= (XQ*GQ), GM1 *= (XQ*UQ)
Run a fused fp32 mul on each MFMA output tile -- no LDS round-trip for scales
If you change the MFMA tile shape (16x16 <-> 32x32), rederive which lane owns the canonical scale before reusing the broadcast
expected_impact: eliminates LDS traffic for scales; keeps dequant inside the MFMA register cluster
